List gate runs, most recent first, narrowed by any combination of the filters below. Each entry names the branch, the prospective merge commit actually tested, the target, and the verdict -- and, for a failed one, which gate step failed and where to read it.

A RUNNING entry is being gated right now. INCONCLUSIVE means the gate never reached a real verdict (a wrapper timeout, an environment fault) -- read it as unresolved, not as a failure.

Usage:
  erun gate list [flags]

Examples:
  erun gate list --target-branch main
  erun gate list --status FAILED

Flags:
      --dry-run                Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
  -h, --help                   help for list
      --source-branch string   Filter by source branch
      --status string          Filter by status: RUNNING, PASSED, FAILED, or INCONCLUSIVE
      --target-branch string   Filter by target branch

Global Flags:
      --erun-alias string   erun platform cloud alias to target (defaults to the sole configured erun-type alias)
      --output string       Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time                Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count       Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.
